task: Replace whatsapp-web.js with Baileys QR connection; editable templates; premium dashboard
summary: Replaced Codex's whatsapp-web.js/Puppeteer QR attempt with the Antigravity method: @whiskeysockets/baileys@6.7.24 (satisfies ^6.7.19) via makeWASocket + useMultiFileAuthState(data/baileys-auth) + connection.update (QR -> qrcode dataURL) + creds.update/saveCreds + messages.upsert; whatsapp-web.js uninstalled, Dockerfile Chromium lines reverted, zero references to puppeteer/LocalAuth remain in src. Scanned number is read from sock.user.id and normalised by src/whatsapp/jid.ts (jidToPhoneNumber), persisted in new whatsapp_qr_session table; logout clears identity and auth dir so another number can pair. Inbound: fromMe/groups/broadcast filtered, claimWebhookEvent('qr:<id>') dedupe, Arabic-Indic numerals normalised, numbered replies mapped to stable menu IDs via customers.last_menu_options, then the EXISTING processInboundMessage pipeline; replies go back through the same socket via replyTransport (kept from Codex). Templates: reply_templates table with default/draft/live columns seeded from src/templates/defaults.ts (13 templates, no prices/hours/addresses invented); menu.ts and pipeline read live_* only. Automation: automation_settings (auto/rule/AI toggles), per-customer human-handoff pause (support queue), reply_activity log. Dashboard: dark navy theme (theme.css), regrouped nav (19 areas), new pages WhatsApp Connection (QR, dynamic number, connect/refresh/logout, troubleshooting), Auto-Reply Control Center, 3-panel Manual Reply Editor (search/filter, AR/EN RTL-LTR tabs, char count, Save Draft/Publish/Discard/Reset with confirmations + unsaved warning, WhatsApp-style preview 'Preview only'), Support Queue, Flow Map, Analytics, Security, Business, Location; Products/Offers/Price Book shown as honest planned states (no fake data). Meta Cloud API code isolated under 'Providers & Legacy API', not the active channel. OpenRouter openrouter/free untouched. Live verification: server started in production mode, migration 011 applied to the live DB, real Baileys session reached phase 'scan' with a 6.9KB PNG QR returned by /api/dashboard/whatsapp/qr; all new endpoints exercised with a temporary revoked session (draft never changes live text, empty publish rejected 400, toggles persist, 401 without session). Login page rendered in browser with no console errors. NOT verified: real phone scan, real inbound message, published-edit round trip on a real phone (requires the user's phone; agent has no admin password to view authenticated pages).
reason: User-approved correction of Codex's library choice and completion of the approved plan: Baileys QR-only pairing matching the reference project, editable AR/EN templates with strict draft/live separation, preserved pipeline and AI provider, premium dark dashboard.
